Subject: Reseller addendum - initial redlines

Hi Irene / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the technical fit looks good and the commercial team is ready to proceed. Our legal team attached initial redlines to your reseller addendum (see attachment). Two main asks from our side:

- We need a clear path where marketplace fees are passed through to the end customer; CloudCart needs an explicit representation that pricing/tax treatment will not create downstream withholding risk.
- We require indemnity language that covers third-party claims arising from distribution, but we also proposed a limited carveout for supply chain liability tied to reseller-configured integrations.

Wed appreciate Redwoods countermarks on these points by EOD Friday if possible — finance is aligned and wants to start the order form.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@cloudcart.io>, CloudCart Legal <contracts@cloudcart.io>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 09:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum - initial redlines

Irene / team — I reviewed CloudCart's redlines and drafted proposed language. Key points summarized below; full comments attached (Redwood_proposed_carveouts_20270408.docx).

1) Pass-through & tax withholding:
- We can accept explicit pass-through of marketplace fees to end customers provided CloudCart: (i) is the named reseller on the order form, and (ii) confirms in the order form that it will be responsible for any local tax collection/withholding.
- Proposed short clause: "Reseller shall be solely responsible for any taxes, duties, or withholdings assessed on payments made to Reseller, and Redwood will invoice the customer or Reseller consistent with the Order Form."

2) Indemnity carveout request:
- CloudCart's request to carve out "supply chain liability" is ambiguous. We can offer a limited carveout tied to (a) misconfiguration by Reseller of integrations expressly documented in the reseller portal, and (b) Reseller's failure to apply critical security patches it controls.
- Proposed language (high-level): "Redwood's indemnity obligations shall exclude liability arising from Reseller-controlled configuration or failure to apply Reseller-managed security updates, provided such responsibilities are documented in the Reseller Integration Guide and Reseller is given reasonable notice to remediate."

3) Evidence & audit: if CloudCart requires audit rights to verify fee routing, we prefer a narrowly-scoped evidence request (transaction-level reports monthly) rather than full on-site audits.

Open items for us to confirm with Product/Infra (Karthik):
- Whether the order form flow needs changes to indicate "Reseller-bill" vs "End-customer-bill" metadata to satisfy CloudCart's finance team.

Irene / Ben — sales pressure note: keep concessions narrow. Ive prioritized legal language that preserves Redwoods indemnity where upstream product defects are implicated.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Reseller addendum - initial redlines

Team — appreciate the quick turnaround, Laura. From Sales perspective:

- CloudCart is fast-moving and their pipeline is large; we should keep the carveout narrowly written as you suggested and accept the pass-through wording with the condition that the order form clearly states the billing model.
- If Product needs a minor metadata flag in the order form to denote "Reseller-bill", were OK with that work; Karthik, please advise on ETA.
- If legal can get a clean marked version + a 1-paragraph summary of open items by EOD Monday, I will push Finance to sign off on payment terms and get the order form executed.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks — appreciate the detailed reply. Were generally comfortable with the pass-through and the narrow indemnity carveout you proposed. A few clarifications:

- CloudCart will confirm reseller billing on the order form (we can provide a template field).
- We prefer monthly transaction reports for evidence; DocuSign link for signature will follow once Redwood sends the final redlines.

As discussed, were okay to proceed provided the final redlines reflect the clarified language around reseller responsibility for withholding and the carveout is scoped to Reseller-controlled configuration issues.

Proposed next step: Redwood to send final redline PDF + 1-paragraph executive summary; CloudCart to sign via DocuSign.

Maya
